premise: Badger's apple for Beaver is too heavy to carry across the meadow, so Hedgehog curls up, sticks it on his prickles and rolls it all the way to the pond.
inspiration: The folk tale of the gift that arrives in a funny way, turned so the problem (prickles) becomes the solution.
lesson: What makes you different can be exactly what a friend needs.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Delivers an Apple
en-US.text: {badger:enter} Badger came trotting along with a present for his friend {beaver:enter} Beaver: a big red apple. {badger:pulse} But Beaver's pond was across the meadow, and the apple was heavy. {badger:face sad} [sighs] Oof. {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog came scurrying up. {hedgehog:face happy} Leave it to me! [excited] He {hedgehog:live hold} tucked in his nose, curled into a prickly ball, and rolled over the apple. {sfx:squish} Squish! It stuck. {badger:face surprised} Across the meadow he went, {hedgehog:spin x3} roly-poly, roly-poly, the apple going round on top. {sfx:bump} Bump! He stopped by the pond, where Beaver {beaver:live} was gnawing his stick so the chips flew. He held it up, admired it, patted it… {beaver:face surprised} [gasps] and saw the apple! {hedgehog:live resume} Hedgehog slowly uncurled, peeked out and sniffed. {hedgehog:go to beaver} Special delivery! {all:face happy} [happily] They shared it, crunch, crunch. Then {badger:live} Badger sniffed, dug a little hole for the pips, and popped up with earth on his nose, grinning. {beaver:hearts} {hedgehog:hearts} One day, he said, the apples will grow right here.

es-ES.title: Erizo reparte una manzana
es-ES.text: {badger:enter} Tejón llegó trotando con un regalo para su amigo {beaver:enter} Castor: una manzana grande y roja. {badger:pulse} Pero la charca de Castor estaba al otro lado del prado, y la manzana pesaba mucho. {badger:face sad} [sighs] Uf. {hedgehog:enter} Erizo llegó correteando. {hedgehog:face happy} ¡Déjamelo a mí! [excited] {hedgehog:live hold} Escondió la nariz, se hizo una bola pinchuda y rodó por encima de la manzana. {sfx:squish} ¡Chof! Se quedó pinchada. {badger:face surprised} Por el prado que se fue, {hedgehog:spin x3} rueda que rueda, rueda que rueda, con la manzana encima. {sfx:bump} ¡Pum! Se paró junto a la charca, donde Castor {beaver:live} roía su palo y volaban las virutas. Lo levantó, lo admiró, le dio unas palmaditas… {beaver:face surprised} [gasps] ¡y vio la manzana! {hedgehog:live resume} Erizo se desenroscó despacito, asomó la nariz y olisqueó. {hedgehog:go to beaver} ¡Reparto especial! {all:face happy} [happily] La compartieron, ñam. Luego {badger:live} Tejón olfateó, cavó un hoyito para las pepitas y asomó con tierra en la nariz, sonriendo. {beaver:hearts} {hedgehog:hearts} Algún día, dijo, las manzanas crecerán aquí mismo.

squish.prompt: a soft cartoon squish of prickles poking into a crisp apple

bump.prompt: a soft round bump as something rolls to a stop on grass
